map.戈登增长模型估值 使用指南: Gordon Growth Model Valuation User Guide
map.输入预期次年股息、折现率与永续增长率，按 P = D₁/(r−g) 用戈登增长模: Enter expected next-year dividend, discount rate and perpetual growth rate and estimate the intrinsic value of a steady-growth stock with the Gordon model P = D₁/(r−g) — for dividend discount valuation.
map.P = D₁ / (r − g)。 仅适用于 r > g 且增长稳定的股票。: P = D₁ / (r − g). Applies only to stocks with r > g and stable growth.
map.P = D₁ / (r − g)，适用于稳定增长股票。: P = D₁ / (r − g), for steady-growth stocks.
map.稳定增长股利的公司估值（Gordon 模型）。: Valuation of companies with steadily growing dividends (the Gordon model).
map.与 PEG、P/E 交叉验证价值股定价。: Cross-check the valuation of value stocks against PEG and P/E.
map.股息率投资策略的现金流折现基准。: The cash flow discounting basis for dividend yield investment strategies.
map.：若 g=6%：P=2.12/(0.10−0.06)=53 元。增长率小幅提升显: : if g=6%: P=2.12/(0.10−0.06)=53 CNY. A small rise in growth rate sharply lifts the valuation (the denominator is sensitive).
map.每股股利 / 每股收益: Dividend per share / earnings per share
map.由每股收益与股价求盈利收益率: Earnings yield from EPS and share price
map.由市值、债务与现金求企业价值: Enterprise value from market cap, debt and cash
map.由每股自由现金流与股价求收益率: Yield from free cash flow per share and share price
map.r−g 为负或接近 0 怎么办？: What if r−g is negative or near 0?
map.模型要求 r>g，否则估值发散无意义。高成长股 g 接近 r 时结果极不稳定，不: The model requires r>g, otherwise the valuation diverges and is meaningless. When g approaches r for a high-growth stock the result is extremely unstable and the model should not be used.
map.本工具为 Gordon 单阶段。高成长公司应分阶段（前高增、后稳定）贴现，否则低: This tool implements the single-stage Gordon model. High-growth companies should be staged (high growth first, then stable), otherwise the valuation is underestimated.
